description: Create a broadcast to subscribed contacts (optionally filtered by contact data). By default it waits for a human: the response includes approval_url. Hand that link to your operator; clicking it sends. Use dry_run to see recipients, cost, and lint first.

filter.description: Match contacts whose data contains these keys, e.g. { plan: 'pro' }

require_approval.description: Default true. Set false only if your operator has already approved.

name: create_broadcast
title: Create a broadcast
